method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: Tech and chips drive relief rally – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists say a strong semiconductor rally and lower oil prices helped lift global equities. The S&P 500 rebounded as investors rotated from defensive sectors into growth and cyclical stocks, while gains in Micron and SK Hynix reinforced co
Equities.reason: Clear market-regime signal: chip-led rally and rotation into growth is a dominant, market-wide narrative supporting risk assets. Relevance elevated because it describes broad flows and sector leadership rather than a single-stock move.

Equities.title: Equities: Risk of renewed rates volatility – BNY
Equities.summary: BNY strategist David Tam warns that a renewed rise in rates volatility, as measured by the MOVE Index, could pressure U.S. equities, particularly technology and growth segments. He says investors may need to reduce equity exposure, shorten portfolio equity dur
Equities.reason: Macro cross-asset risk: higher rates volatility is a clear headwind for equity risk-premia, especially growth/tech. Included for its direct transmission into equity positioning and potential to flip regime.

Equities.title: Stocks climb, oil slides as tech hopes outlast Middle East worries
Equities.reason: Broad-market read: markets are putting more weight on tech/AI optimism than on geopolitical oil-risk. Relevant because it captures the net effect on global equity sentiment.

Equities.title: SK Hynix's US listing sparks rush of single-stock ETF filings
Equities.reason: Structural flow implication: a major US listing driving new ETF product filings boosts liquidity and demand for chip exposure — amplifies the chip/AI leadership narrative and potential index/ETF flows into equities.

Equities.title: Chip stocks boost global markets ahead of SK Hynix blockbuster US debut
Equities.reason: High-relevance market mover: collective chip momentum (and SK Hynix supply story) is a dominant driver of equity moves, outweighing geopolitical noise and materially shaping risk-on behaviour.

Equities.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip as investors eye SK Hynix listing, Middle East risks
Equities.reason: Near-term positioning/volatility signal: caution ahead of a major listing and geopolitical flare-ups can blunt the chip-led rally. Included as a counter-signal with moderate relevance.

Equities.title: A huge trade just happened on the Nasdaq 100. Bulls are taking notice
Equities.summary: Tech bulls may not have to wait much longer for fresh highs, if the single-biggest trade in the Invesco QQQ Trust ETF on Thursday is any indication.
Equities.reason: Positioning signal: large options/ETF trades into Nasdaq reflect bullish conviction and can reinforce tech leadership. Lower relevance than fundamental flow stories but useful for market mechanics.

Equities.title: TRADING DAY What war? Chip-led rally helps markets ignore on-again, off-again US-Iran truce
Equities.reason: Narrative confirmation: reiterates that chip/tech momentum is the dominant driver allowing markets to discount geopolitical risk — reinforces the prevailing regime assessment.

Equities.title: Tech Stock Jitters Just Went Off the Charts
Equities.reason: Volatility-specific counterpoint: sharp rises in tech volatility are a warning sign for the sustainability of the rally. Included at lower relevance as a cautionary, market-structure signal.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes revealing a split and discussion of further hikes feed a higher-for-longer rates narrative. This is high-impact policy information likely to push yields up (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Fed officials fret over inflation risk, weigh rate hikes
Rates.reason: Reporting that Fed officials are worried about inflation and considering hikes reinforces policy upside risk and the selloff-in-bonds / higher-yields narrative.

Rates.title: Kalshi traders see roughly 50% odds of a rate hike in 2026 as Fed is split on policy
Rates.summary: Wednesday's Fed minutes showed a divided outlook on where interest rates are headed this year. Traders on Kalshi see a 54% likelihood of a hike before 2027.
Rates.reason: Market-implied odds rising for additional hikes signal repricing of policy risk into rates (pressure on bond prices / higher yields).

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: No near-term hikes signalled – Commerzbank
Rates.summary: Commerzbank’s Dr. Christoph Balz and Bernd Weidensteiner interpret recent data and Fed communications as pointing to stable policy rates in coming months.
Rates.reason: A reputable market view arguing for no near-term hikes is a counter-signal that could support a modest bond rally (yields down). Relevance is lower versus direct Fed minutes/comments.

Rates.title: Wall St Week Ahead Investors to grapple with packed week of earnings, CPI, Iran headlines
Rates.reason: Preview highlighting upcoming CPI and macro data elevates near-term rate volatility risk; the prospect of hotter CPI would push yields higher (negative for bonds).

FX.title: Euro: Yield spreads hint at recovery against US Dollar – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny highlights that European Central Bank (ECB) minutes added little new information but confirmed openness to another rate hike, consistent with MUFG’s call for a 25bp move in September.
FX.reason: ECB hawkish tilt and yield-spread support point to EUR recovery vs USD. Relevant to USD-centric FX flows (EURUSD upside), but single-bank note limits relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar: Geopolitics faded as markets eye rates – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole notes the US Dollar (USD) has been broadly unchanged despite renewed Middle East tensions, as Oil has retraced and risk sentiment improved.
FX.reason: Notes USD resilience/limited reaction to geopolitics — small tilt to dollar weakness as risk backdrop and oil retracement reduce safe-haven flows. Modest relevance as a short-term market colour piece.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index extends losses as US and Iran attempt to resume talks
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) is trading lower for the third consecutive day on Friday.
FX.reason: Clear USD weakening signal (DXY down) — directly relevant to broad USD-centric FX basket and risk-on dynamics; solid relevance for intraday regime shift.

FX.title: PBOC Signals Comfort With Yuan Gains as Fixing Set Below 6.8
FX.reason: PBOC tolerance of a stronger CNY/fixing below 6.8 is a meaningful FX policy signal that reduces USD strength vs CNY — high relevance for EM/Asia FX and global dollar demand.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Policy shift talk supports JPY – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny notes the Japanese Yen is leading G10 gains after Finance Minister Katayama unexpectedly urged households and the GPIF to increase investments in Japanese financial assets.
FX.reason: Government/pension flow talk is driving JPY strength — a direct FX-native catalyst supporting JPY vs USD and other G10 currencies; meaningful but still part of evolving narrative.

FX.title: Japan signals pension push into domestic assets, sparking rally in yen, bonds
FX.reason: Reinforces the government-driven bid for JPY and long-end JGBs via pension/GPIF flows — increases relevance of sustained JPY appreciation narrative vs USD.

FX.title: Fragile yen set for weekly decline as intervention risks mount
FX.reason: Highlights downside pressure on JPY and potential intervention, a counter-signal to the rally; included with lower relevance as an important risk-off/intervention warning rather than dominant flow.

FX.title: RBI Faces $100 Billion Challenge After Record Currency Defense
FX.reason: Large FX reserve draw to defend INR implies persistent USD demand and potential USD strength vs EMFX — significant for EM flow/backstop dynamics; negative sign reflects USD strength as a drag across the USD-centric basket.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar: Firmer against US Dollar – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale strategists highlight that USD/CAD is tactically expensive versus the 2-year spread and has recently met resistance near 1.4250 before retracing toward 1.4130.
FX.reason: Tactical CAD strength vs USD (USD/CAD resistance and retracement) is relevant for North American USD flows; bank-stratamental note with moderate relevance.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Dollar finds resistance at the 161.75 previous support
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) holds losses below 161.75 against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Friday following a 100-pip reversal earlier on the day.
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece showing USD weakness vs JPY intraday — priced-focused so lower relevance under the scoring rules.

FX.title: US Dollar: AI-driven imports reshape trade – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur says AI-related capital-goods imports are structurally widening the US trade deficit. Strong foreign demand currently helps finance the gap, but weaker confidence in the United States (US) AI (Artificial intelligence) investment stor
FX.reason: Structural trade-flow argument that AI capital imports may widen the US deficit and weigh on USD over time — relevant structural dollar pressure (higher relevance than a pure technical note).

Commodities.title: Gold: Tentative stabilisation on oil relief – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC strategists Christopher Wong and Sim Moh Siong highlight that Gold has rebounded as Oil prices eased, reducing inflation and Fed tightening concerns, while a softer US Dollar also supported the move.
Commodities.reason: Gold rebound tied to lower oil and softer USD — a direct, market-relevant bullish signal for gold prices (macro drivers: commodity/FX transmission).

Commodities.title: Gold seems vulnerable near $4,100 as USD rebounds amid Fed hike bets and Iran risks
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) touches a fresh low during the first half of the European session on Friday, with bears looking to extend the intraday descent further below the $4,100 mark.
Commodities.reason: Intraday/technical downside on gold as USD strength and rate-hike bets weigh; price-action/technical piece — capped relevance per framework.

Commodities.title: Gold heads for weekly drop as Gulf attacks reinforce rate-hike bets
Commodities.reason: Market-moving thematic: Gulf attacks are tightening rate-path bets, reinforcing Fed hike expectations and pressuring gold — high relevance to gold price regime.

Commodities.title: Gold Steadies as Traders Weigh Mideast Tensions and Rate Outlook
Commodities.reason: Mixed/neutral intraday piece: tensions supportive but rate outlook offsets — modestly positive but low relevance as it’s a status/update rather than a clear directional catalyst.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $59.47 per troy ounce, down 0.86% from the $59.98 it cost on Thursday.
Commodities.reason: Short-term price decline in silver (intraday/data-driven). Technical/price update — lower relevance per framework.

Commodities.title: Oil Prices Wobble As a Week of Hostilities Derails Shipping
Commodities.reason: Shipping disruptions and hostilities in key chokepoints materially raise short-term oil supply risk and insurance costs — a significant bullish macro catalyst for oil.

Commodities.title: IEA confirms: Oil demand to rise by 1.2M bpd YoY in Q4
Commodities.summary: According to the latest forecast from the International Energy Agency (IEA), the global Oil demand will rise by 1.2 million barrels per day (bpd) Year-on-Year (YoY) in the last quarter of this year.
Commodities.reason: IEA demand upgrade for Q4 is a clear demand-side bullish input for oil prices and materially relevant to market balances.

Commodities.title: World oil demand set for first annual decline since 2020, IEA says
Commodities.summary: Renewed escalation in the U.S.-Iran war could complicate matters and further cloud the outlook, the IEA warned Friday.
Commodities.reason: IEA assessment of annual demand decline is structurally bearish for oil; relevant macro-supply/demand signal that offsets shorter-term geopolitical risk.

Commodities.title: UAE’s Oil Output Surged to Record High in June, IEA Says
Commodities.reason: Record UAE production raises near-term supply availability — a meaningful supply-side offset to geopolitical risk, bearish for prices.

Commodities.title: The United States produced more crude oil than any other country in 2025
Commodities.summary: The United States remained the world's largest crude oil producer in 2025, according to our International Energy Statistics database, extending a streak that began in 2018 when the United States overtook Russia to become the world's leading producer.
Commodities.reason: EIA data showing sustained high US production points to structural supply resilience — bearish-to-neutral influence on oil price trajectory.

Commodities.title: U.S. exports of crude oil and petroleum products reached record in April
Commodities.summary: U.S. petroleum exports reached a record in April as disruptions to international crude oil and refined product flows through the Strait of Hormuz increased global demand for U.S. exports. Exports increased to 13.6 million barrels per day (b/d) in April, 15% mo
Commodities.reason: Record U.S. export flows indicate stronger global pull for US barrels amid regional disruptions — supportive for near-term oil balances/prices.

Commodities.title: Oil: Brent retraces gains on fragile ceasefire – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank strategist Molly Schwartz notes that Brent Oil traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains constrained despite a nominal ceasefire between the US and Iran. War insurance costs have risen sharply and shipowners are being advised to pause Hormuz voyage
Commodities.reason: Headline focuses on a price retrace after a fragile ceasefire — near-term pullback but underlying supply chokepoint and insurance-cost dynamics keep the story relevant (moderate significance).

Crypto.title: Billions flowing out of bitcoin ETFs and private credit funds suggest rising market risks
Crypto.reason: Large ETF and private-credit outflows are a clear liquidity and sentiment negative for crypto markets. High relevance because flows directly affect price discovery and leverage dynamics across BTC and broader crypto.

Crypto.title: Live markets: Bitcoin tops $64,000 as selling pressure on Coinbase eases
Crypto.reason: On-chain and ETF-related selling pressure easing with BTC pushing above $64k is a near-term bullish signal for spot and ETF flows; medium relevance as it reflects immediate price action and flows.

Crypto.title: Crypto defies equity weakness as altcoin optimism builds into the weekend
Crypto.reason: Shows risk-on rotation into altcoins and relative crypto resilience vs equities — reinforces an altcoin-led demand narrative with meaningful market impact.

Crypto.title: Arbitrum jumps 19% benefitting from Robinhood's $568 million onchain trading frenzy
Crypto.reason: Large single-asset move driven by retail/onchain flow (Robinhood) signals strong demand transmission to L2/alt markets — meaningful for market structure and liquidity distribution across crypto.

Crypto.title: Polymarket seeks approval to bring margin trading to U.S. customers
Crypto.reason: Regulatory approval to offer margin in the U.S. would expand on‑chain leverage and volumes — positive for activity but increases systemic leverage risk; medium-low relevance until approved.

Crypto.title: Swift rolls out new blockchain ledger to bring 24/7 banking to 17 global giants
Crypto.reason: Major institutional payments infrastructure adopting blockchain 24/7 is a high-impact adoption story that improves rails and could increase institutional crypto flows — significant positive for long-term demand and integration.

Crypto.title: Latin America’s biggest stock exchange now offers options on bitcoin, ether and solana futures
Crypto.reason: Introduction of regulated derivatives on a major regional exchange expands institutional access and risk-management tools — a constructive structural development for crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Over $7.2 billion have migrated from LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP as Mantle joins exodus
Crypto.reason: Large on-chain liquidity migration across cross‑chain messaging protocols indicates shifting infrastructure preference and token flow concentration — relevant for network-level valuation and short-term flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's $60,000-$70,000 range becomes third longest consolidation in history
Crypto.reason: Long-duration consolidation at a high price band signals structural stability and reduced volatility risk — modestly positive but primarily technical, so lower relevance.

Crypto.title: Metaplanet explores bringing bitcoin-backed digital credit to Japan
Crypto.reason: Plans to create BTC‑backed digital credit in a major market (Japan) are a constructive product/credit innovation that could deepen BTC utility and lending demand; medium-low relevance until implemented.
